# Nymrel Machine Trust

> Machine Trust generates and audits machine-readable web evidence without inventing ownership, performance, or discovery outcomes.

## Core modules

Generators and validators for inspectable web evidence.

- [JSON-LD generator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/jsonLd.ts): Builds Schema.org graphs from explicit configuration and canonical creator references.
- [Machine index generator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/llmsTxt.ts): Creates token-budgeted llms.txt and llms-full.txt files.
- [Crawler policy generator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/generators/robotsTxt.ts): Creates declared crawler rules that remain subject to each crawler's behavior.
- [DOM parity validator](https://github.com/nymrel/nymrel-machine-trust/blob/main/src/validators/domConsistency.ts): Reports observable differences between configured structured data and supplied HTML.

## Optional

- [Nymrel](https://nymrel.com): Company services, products, and proof.
